summary: In August 2023 Toyota halted 28 production lines at all 14 of its Japanese plants after maintenance on its parts-ordering system hit a disk space error. The backup system failed too, so there was no automatic switchover.

overview.background: Toyota's production schedule depends on a parts ordering system. Database maintenance on 28 August 2023 involved cleanup and reorganisation of data.
overview.impact: Production stopped on 29 August 2023 on 28 lines at all 14 plants, according to the report.
overview.severity: A stop of the entire domestic production for about a day.
overview.gaps: This file is based on a news report and gives no hours or volume figures.

timeline.e: Maintenance begins on the parts ordering database to clean up and reorganise data.
An error occurs due to insufficient disk space.
The backup function also fails, so there is no automatic switchover.
Data is moved to a server with more storage and operations resume.

rootCause.trigger: A database cleanup and reorganisation caused an error from insufficient disk space.
rootCause.underlying: The system stopped after an error due to insufficient disk space.
contributing: The backup function failed too, so no automatic switchover
Storage headroom was not enough for the work

evidence.label: What stopped the system
evidence.body: the system stopped after an error occurred due to insufficient disk space

evidence.note: A sample check. Numbers are invented.

diagnose.step: Check disk usage and free space.
Check why the standby did not take over.

correct.step: Move data to a server with more storage.

verify.step: Check orders flow and lines run.
Check the new server has headroom.

prevent.step: Alert at 70 and 85 percent of disk.

fix.safety: Moving data under pressure risks loss. Take a backup copy first and verify after.

troubleshoot.scenario: Disk is full during maintenance and the standby also failed. Production depends on this system.
troubleshoot.question: What do you do?
troubleshoot.answer: Stop the maintenance, move the data to a larger server, restart ordering and bring lines back.

remediation.answer: Alert at 80 percent and predict time to full.
Allow manual ordering for a day.

design.prompt: Design a production ordering system that survives a full disk.
design.answer: Capacity headroom, equal standby, tested failover, read-only fallback, maintenance runbooks with checks.

options: The report says it was a disk space error
Moving data to a server with more storage
